sections.what_happened: Trump signed EO Friday Oct 16 waiving key sanctions + tariffs under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (passed by Congress September, targeting Russian officials/oligarchs/financial institutions + up to 100% tariffs on top buyers of Russian oil/gas incl. India, China), two days before measures took effect. Trump: 'A lot of you don't know what my decision is yet'; Rubio: 60-day review to analyze impact on global + US economy, citing Iran war, Ansar Allah attacks on Saudi Arabia, Ukraine war energy pressures; India 'cannot stop buying Russian oil overnight'. Zelenskyy warned it emboldens Putin and prolongs the war. Oil: Brent eased Monday to $108.3 (-1.42%), WTI $101.2, after briefly hitting $110 Friday.
sections.what_verified: Reuters, Straits Times, Economic Times, Business Times (Oct 18), The Federal, Daily Pioneer, TOI (oil prices Monday). Zelenskyy criticism widely carried.
sections.what_disputed: Rubio's defense: waiver authority was built into the Act; review is economic-pragmatic (midterms, energy prices), not a policy abandonment. Diesel deal context (Oct 9 call) supports pragmatic reading.
sections.why_matters: The sanctions-vs-reality crack: Washington writes a pressure law, then shelves it before it bites — because the Iran war and Ansar Allah strikes already lit energy prices. 'The split, not the bloc' — US real interests diverging from Kyiv/Europe. Pocketbook first: what $110 Brent and diesel prices cost viewers.
sections.context: Background: Trump signed EO Friday waiving Graham Act Russia sanctions/tariffs; Rubio: 60-day review — ELEVATION: major sanctions change
